# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-08-07
Prior cache: v3.10 Team MCP marketplace (reported 2026-07-04).

## August 2026 [NEW — REPORTED]
- Aug 3 — **Google Workspace Plugins**: agents get direct read/write/act access to Gmail, Google Drive,
  Calendar, Docs and Sheets via Google's remote MCP servers. Drive: search, read, create, share, manage
  files. Gmail: search, read, draft, label, manage email. Calendar: list calendars, search events.
  Installed from the Cursor Marketplace / Customize page (~5 clicks).
  https://cursor.com/changelog/google-workspace-plugins

## July 2026 [below the watching-tier bar]
- Jul 29 — Cursor on iPad (all paid plans); inbox; expanded PR review; split-screen; Apple Pencil markup.
- Jul 28 — Cursor Start plan for India (Grok 4.5 + Composer, cloud agents, iOS remote control, UPI).
- Jul 22 — **Cursor Router**: model router behind Auto mode with Cost / Balance / Intelligence modes;
  admins control enablement, restrict modes, and manage model access per team or group.
  (Governance-relevant but a routing/config feature, not a new capability surface — held below bar.)
- Jul 17 — Cursor in Slack: task plans before execution, multi-repo with mid-task repo switching,
  cross-channel message reading and posting.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Watching tier. One item clears the "major new capability" bar: Google Workspace
plugins put corporate mail/file/calendar data inside a coding agent.
